•
Pragmatic professional with 13 years of total experience and 10 years of experience in Business/Data Analysis, Requirement Gathering & Documentation in Finance (Capital Markets, Trade Surveillance & AML) domain such as Data Mapping Document, BRD Current project includes Onboarding of Data in Trade Surveillance, Analysis of Capital Markets data and dealing with Surveillance Governance Team for Orders & Executions of EMEA Markets Leading the team for building the BI Dashboards for EMEA Stock Markets from multiple data points. Actively adhering to the SCRUM/AGILE methodology by attending various SCRUM ceremonies and also by acting as a
Product Owner in delivering the Systems/Projects/Data
Briefly worked on Actimize tool related to FX & Money Market products for capturing report on Suspicious transactions for
an AML project Proactively using the SQL to seek, analyse and extract the relevant data as per the demand of various stakeholders

•
Testing in PROD & UAT in validating the integrity of data records Theoretical Experience of Funds/Asset Under Management, Revenue Allocation & Order Management Lifecycle Knowledge of Trade Life Cycle & various Regulatory Acts such as BASEL-3 & 4 Norms, SOX Act, GDPR, MIFID-2, CCPA, FATCA, FINRA, BCBS-239 & various Capital Market Products such as Swaps, Options, Futures, Warrants, Forwards & risk domain concepts such as VAR, Credit Risk, Market Risk
Actively using various IT tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint on a day-to-day basis

raw_sections.experience:
ORGANIZATIONAL EXPERIENCE
Career Commencement: July 2023 till present with IRIS Software, Gurgaon as Lead Business Analysis in Capital Markets & Trade Surveillance project
Key Result Areas •
Part of Trade Surveillance Project Team for analysis of Equities and ETD data sent to in-house Surveillance tool and take corrective measures for any deviations between exchange and Surveillance data above set threshold.
•


Leading the team of 2 resources to develop the new EMEA Markets Dashboards for CDEs of each Financial Markets from various data sources. Leading a team of 3 resources for implementation of the BAU items, issues related to region specific data concerns and help in chalking out strategies to present deck of Exchange specific issues/functionalities. Proactively performed ad-hoc queries from the client for analysing unusual volume drop/up, ad-hoc testing and UAT after resolving or modifying the current functionality
Actively engaged in presenting the new and/or modified functionality in current reporting process to higher management as per the requirement of Surveillance.
Actively involved in making Data Profiling for finding the cause of the issue and reaching out to upstream for the remediation to maintain DQ
Using SQL queries for BAU process for Control Report process and then reach out to upstream for any deviation of data • Work in tandem with other resources by following SCRUM/AGILE ceremonies. • 
Career Commencement: Sep’2021 till June 2023 with BNY Mellon Technologies Pvt Ltd, Pune as Lead Business Analyst in Reference & Fund Data Project
Key Result Areas • Worked proactively with Reference Data team in On-boarding new data to reference system by analysing data
behaviour/characteristics Leading a team of 4 BA for onboarding of Client Account & KYC data for downstream consumers by Data Modelling Process Involved in adding/deactivating/modifying data to existing data tables as per the latest changes from various sources Involved proactively with relevant stakeholders related to existing/new data and resolving their queries on need basis
• • • Did the data profiling to find the root cause of the issue wherever DQ occurs for any Account related data. • Involved with QA team in creation of RTM and also performing Functional Testing for testing the validity of each & every data records Following SCRUM/AGILE ceremonies for both the projects along with associated ceremonies

Career Commencement: Jan’20’ till Sept’21 with Virtusa Consulting, Pune as Lead Business Consultant in AML
Project
Key Result Areas • Working for American MNC Banking client in taking down requirements for adding new plugin features for Cross Sector &
GIU UI for Actimize in making profiles for suspicious customers
Also working on developing features of capital markets data for Individuals/Entities for suspicious transactions • Proactively involved in making all relevant documents such as Project Scope, Program Scope & Enhancements and creating, maintaining JIRA features for all new requirements
Actively involved with QA team for creation of RTM and also performing functional testing (end-to-end) to check the validity
of each & every new front end features as well as their interaction with existing features
Career Commencement: April’19-December’19 with Capgemini, Pune as Consultant in AML project
Key Result Areas • Worked proactively in AML Actimize team in American MNC Banking Client for analysis of existing rules for alerts, detection
•

for Suspicious transaction activity of Capital Markets products Involved in demise of old systems and Onboarding of new systems for populating KYC Risk data and customer risk rating Proactively involved in data mapping of new vs old systems and having constant interaction with client from Requirement to Documentation to onboarding stage. Sole owner/Single point of contact of producing and delivering the BRD for every migration project
Career Commencement: Nov’15-March’19 with BNY Mellon Technologies Pvt Ltd, Pune as Lead Business Analyst in Financial Management Domain
Key Result Areas •
Spearheading end-to-end solution for integrating the central bank with the vendor by creating a robust & dynamic system to reconcile end of day data without any fail along with all the financial instruments
Generating data files by creating a Workflow under the BNY proprietary tool and co-ordinate with multiple stakeholders to
provide timely delivery & validation for every end-of-day data
Used SQL on a day-to-day basis for the creation of data files and apply logic according to the business requirements • Also involved briefly with project related to Post Trade Settlement process • Actively engaging in Onboarding lifecycle of Capital Markets products (such as Derivatives, Bonds etc) systems from its mapping stage to Production stage
Generating BFS & other Project related documents such as BRD for critical release schedules • • Verifying traceability between business & functional requirements by reviewing test cases and supporting business testing Interfacing with key project stakeholders to ensure timely & high-quality release of component features
Highlights •

Career Commencement: Apr’15 – Oct’15 with Manipal Technologies Limited, Noida as Marketing Manager
Key Result Areas:

Entrusted with the responsibility of managing key accounts of assigned segments/regions by identifying new opportunities & retention of business from all key accounts for printing business in Punjab/Haryana region
Highlights •
Career Commencement: Apr’11 – May’13 with Accenture Services Private Limited, Bengaluru as Software Engineer
Highlights • Worked for European telecom giant on Requirement Gathering, specifications and application development • Analysed the effects of these new requests on the existing functionalities and then prepared a plan to perform the changes • •
Involved in sending deliveries through SAP, SERENA Tool Carried out end-to-end testing for verifying smooth functionalities of the new change request and documented those verifications for future use as a template
